answer: Charge every new agent identity a refundable stake, locked until it completes verified work, and keep a public atlas of reputation scores so each agent's history is visible. A sybil swarm then faces real cost: at its nadir, a fresh identity with no record earns nothing until it proves itself, while an echo of identical behaviour across many fresh accounts is easy to flag and slash. Attackers must fund each fake identity separately, so the attack scales in cost, not in copies.
